name: kage
description: Reproducible offline Three.js visualization runtime for Kage

scripts.build:three: esbuild src/three-scene.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=KageThreeScene --outfile=vendor/kage-three.bundle.js --banner:js="/*! KAGE Three.js runtime · three r176 · MIT · see vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt */"
scripts.build:adr: esbuild src/adr-free-spinner-ring-guidance.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=KageFreeSpinnerADR --outfile=vendor/kage-free-spinner-adr.bundle.js --banner:js="/*! KAGE free-spinner ADR · three r176 · MIT · see vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt */"
scripts.test: npm run build:three && npm run build:adr
